component.name: OneNote Viewer
component.summary: View and search local Microsoft OneNote notebooks

description.p: OneNote Viewer is a native, read-only Linux application for opening, rendering, indexing, and searching local Microsoft OneNote notebooks while preserving their freeform page layout.
It opens native OneNote sections, notebook directories, and OneNote package exports without converting pages to HTML or Markdown.
Restore the last opened page across restarts, make page headers selectable, and add safe attachment open and save actions. Stored previews and file-type icons now improve embedded-file fidelity.
Improve page fidelity by retaining complete equation ink, reflowing text and mathematics from measured heights, and rendering newly visible content reliably while scrolling long pages.

Activate explicit OneNote hyperlinks and optionally recognize plain visible links. This release also restores revisioned list content, corrects rich-text line breaks, and persists synchronized page zoom.
Display mathematical formulas with their original structure, including fractions, roots, scripts, matrices, and large operators. This release also improves navigation selection and page timestamps.
Correct Flatpak application metadata, stable-branch packaging, and versioned release artifacts.
